heading: Frequently Asked Questions
text2: Quick answers to the questions we hear most about this service.

items.question: Do you create the game art?
items.answer: Yes. Our artists create characters, environments, UI and animations.

items.question: Can you build multiplayer games?
items.answer: Yes. We build real-time and turn-based multiplayer with a scalable backend.

items.question: 2D or 3D: which is better?
items.answer: It depends on genre, budget and audience. We advise based on your concept.

items.question: How long does 2d/3d game development take?
items.answer: A simple casual game takes about 2 to 3 months, while a polished 3D or multiplayer game usually takes 6 months or more.

items.question: Do you offer support after launch?
items.answer: Yes. We provide maintenance, updates, monitoring and new feature development after launch.
